issue: Contradiction: aud-ss-26 keys the superseded pre-SSARS 25 rule ('Disclose it in a paragraph'; explanation: departures are disclosed in a separate paragraph of the review report), and its option (b) feedback implies a review can't be adverse. aud-ss-07 in the same module correctly keys a qualified or adverse review conclusion.
evidence: SSARS No. 25 (effective for reviews of periods ending on or after Dec 15, 2021) replaced the 'disclose the departure in a separate paragraph' review report with modified conclusions: qualified when the misstatement is material, adverse when it is material and pervasive, each with a 'Basis for Qualified (Adverse) Conclusion' section. aud-ss-07's own explanation states this. A student who answers aud-ss-26 using aud-ss-07's rule finds no option for it and is told the old rule is correct.
source: SSARS No. 25; AR-C 90 (modified conclusions)
fix: Change aud-ss-26 option (d) to 'Modify the conclusion: qualified, or adverse if the effects are pervasive' and keep it as the key. Rewrite the explanation to match aud-ss-07. Make option (b) 'Issue an adverse audit opinion' with the feedback 'A review expresses a conclusion, not an opinion'.

issue: Contradiction on year-specific due dates. Exam items reg-x5-41 (2025 Form 1065 keyed 'March 15, 2026') and reg-x5-44 (2025 S election keyed 'March 15, 2025') ignore the weekend rule. tcp-po-06 keys March 16, 2026, tcp-sc2-01 keys March 17, 2025, and the platform's own TBS (reg-tbs-x5-research, tcp-tbs-u4-k1) and content/tcp/review/tcp-numbers.md use March 16, 2026.
evidence: Python datetime: March 15, 2026 is a Sunday and March 15, 2025 is a Saturday. Under IRC §7503 the deadline moves to the next business day: Monday March 16, 2026 and Monday March 17, 2025. A student drilled on tcp-po-06 or reg-tbs-x5-research would look for March 16 and find it missing. The keyed option is the only defensible one among the choices, so the key isn't wrong, but the stated date is not the actual deadline.
fix: reg-x5-41: change option (c) to 'March 16, 2026 (March 15 is a Sunday)' and add §7503 to the explanation. reg-x5-44: change option (b) to 'March 17, 2025 (March 15 is a Saturday)' with the same note. Or drop the year from both stems and answers, as reg-pt-08 and reg-sc-16 do.

issue: Contradiction: aud-qm-13 keys 'Listed-entity audits and others required' as the SQMS No. 1 engagement-quality-review requirement. aud-qm-23 keys 'Those the firm designates' plus those required by law or regulation. The module lesson (SQMS No. 2 section) also omits any listed-entity trigger. The listed-entity requirement comes from IAASB ISQM 1, not the AICPA standard.
evidence: AICPA SQMS No. 1 (QM 10.34f) requires EQRs for (i) engagements where law or regulation requires one and (ii) engagements the firm determines need one in response to assessed quality risks. Unlike ISQM 1, it has no listed-entity criterion (issuer audits get EQRs under PCAOB AS 1220). The lesson says: 'Required for engagements the firm's policies specify ... and where required by law or regulation.'
